notes.title: Trucktown July 12th Patch notes
notes.content:
[p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b]
🎨 [b]New Feature: Color Change Gates[/b]
Driving through the new color gates will now repaint your car with the last color you picked up.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where players could get stuck under bridges.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed auto reset not working when vehicle gets stuck.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: Trucktown - Desert Area
notes.content:
[h1][/h1][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549985/e90b4c82c69a03fad08844873b8b2dcaa411d2e0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549985/e068dab88515373c1d3faa898604a0f976d817f5.png"][/img][/carousel][h1]
Patch Notes - Version Update[/h1][h2]🌍 World & Environment[/h2][h3]Desert Area Expansion[/h3][list][*][p][b]Desert area is now complete[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new destructible desert houses with detailed breakable components[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new road network throughout the desert region[/p][/*][*][p]New destructible desert tents scattered throughout the area[/p][/*][/list][h3]Day/Night Cycle System[/h3][list][*][p][b]Major overhaul of day/night cycle mechanics[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Cycle duration set to 24 minutes real-time (16 minutes day, 8 minutes night)[/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic night music [/p][/*][*][p]Automatic music swapping based on time of day[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced nighttime visuals with starry sky effects[/p][/*][*][p]Street lights activate only during night hours[/p][/*][/list][h2]🎮 Gameplay & Mechanics[/h2][list][*][p]Complete rework of mission fireworks[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Firetruck enhancement[/b]: Increased top speed and reduced vehicle mass for better handling and responsiveness[/p][/*][/list][h2]🔧 Technical Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed missing audio tag causing break sound issues[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]General map polishing and optimization improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced breakable object interactions across desert environment[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tree destruction physics[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced object flipping probability for more natural destruction behaviour[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][i]Note: This update focuses heavily on expanding the desert region and improving the day/night cycle experience. Players can expect a more immersive environment with better lighting, sound, and destruction mechanics.[/i][/p]
